headline: BetterBags Next adds a Gap Between Sections option to keep side-by-side sections apart.

entries.title: Gap Between Sections option for BetterBags Next
entries.details: Adds a Gap Between Sections toggle to each bag's Layout tab under Sections in BetterBags Next, off by default. When enabled with multiple columns, an empty icon cell separates side-by-side sections so categories stand apart. Windows without enough room show fewer columns.
